answer: Each epoch's pool splits equally among the verified responders, so every extra fake identity dilutes an operator's own share by 0.3 while costing a full 1000-POA stake to quill-hold. Marginal return per account falls as the farm grows, making the shale investment unprofitable past a few identities. The split is recomputed from the settled answer list at close and recorded in the jade payout log.
